lark_e10_entry.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry.text: The proposed comparison on Day Seventy Five had a consequence more tangible than applause. The association's current operating keeper needed one qualified person for a separate two hour inspection on Day Seventy Seven. Six copper would be paid after its actual receiving. The appointment concerned the stopped comparison apparatus, not authority over the freight bell. Candidates needed a received public task record under the posted conditions. Rao had offered to stand for the appointment. Lin could enter the same public comparison, or take the mandatory course comparison privately without entering that recruitment.

lark_e10_entry_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_002.text: On Day Seventy Four, Duan read the conditions with her in the low practice room. The established four pairs would each carry their own permitted quarter unit task, with the unchanged half unit input ceiling spread across four ordinary breaths and full grounded release. Changed order would test control without asking Lin's incomplete fifth pair to perform. Current apparatus and recovery checks would precede either public or private work. Rao would demonstrate the same four tasks within his six stable primary pair competence. Neither form offered Lin an easier criterion simply because the observer wanted a good story.

lark_e10_entry_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_003.text: The public record could be used for the ordinary apparatus appointment if she completed the required tasks reliably. It would also show whatever she failed to complete. The private course report would give her the same measured comparison under the received curriculum, but its restricted receiving would not qualify her for this public appointment. Her existing safe paid desk place would continue in either case. Duan would not let a chance at six extra copper make a novice treat the difference between careful work and successful work as a personal disgrace.

lark_e10_entry_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_004.text: Lin asked whether Rao's additional stable pairs made the comparison unfair. Duan said they made Rao better prepared, which was a fact rather than a procedural trick. He had repeated changes of order Lin still found difficult. The posted four pair task allowed her to use every established route she had, without inventing a fifth certificate. It did not make the two people equally trained. A comparison could be safe and clear while still being unfavorable to one entrant. She needed to decide whether its public consequence was worth accepting.

lark_e10_entry_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_005.text: Jiang Tao checked the room's board and the ordinary disconnect that morning. The public demonstration would use a marked audience boundary in the same room, with no observers standing over the operator's shoulder. The private report would use no audience except competent receivers. The two sessions occupied successive received slots, so both candidates could rest between their own task and observing the other. There was no demand to race discharge or reduce the rest intervals for entertainment. Lin could lose through incomplete control; she would not be required to gamble safety against speed.

lark_e10_entry_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_006.text: Rao arrived for the preparatory meeting with his current recovery report. It supported the limited seated task that day, including the actual reserve needed for the scope. He did not promise the knee would support standing afterward. Lin asked whether he expected her to enter publicly. He said he expected her to choose for herself and expected to perform the tasks more reliably if she did. The honesty irritated her for a moment. It was easier to feel generous toward someone who promised she might surprise him than toward someone who let preparation matter.

lark_e10_entry_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_007.text: Rao saw the irritation and did not soften his answer into a prophecy. He had worked hard for the control he now carried, with failures that had not been charming opportunities for another person to look exceptional. He wanted the six copper inspection job because his current knee limited some other ordinary work. The appointment suited what he could safely perform. Lin realized that his advantage belonged to a livelihood, not merely a wall placed before her progress. Winning would matter to him, and an unexplained loss would not be kind.

lark_e10_entry_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_008.text: Shan Fang could attend the public slot after her lesson if Lin chose it. She could not attend the private assessment, whose receiving scope did not include household spectators. She offered neither attendance as a prize for courage. Lin said she was trying to distinguish wanting a useful public record from wanting people to admire her for volunteering. Shan Fang said the distinction might become easier after Lin admitted she wanted both. The second desire would not make the first false. It might make stopping harder when the useful task began to fail.

lark_e10_entry_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_009.text: Lin went alone to the lower wall before answering. A porter was resting beside an unfilled load basket, with his shoulder strap hanging loose. He had accepted a smaller booking under the reduced gallery rating and was waiting for the actual receiving window. The empty basket could look like failure from the far stair. It was preparation for an agreed job. Lin wished she could keep every observer close enough to understand the same distinction at her own board. A public record could carry the task conditions. It could not make every spectator read them.

lark_e10_entry_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_entry_010.text: She returned with an answer before the keeper fixed the audience places. The mandatory comparison would be performed under the accepted course either way, and her current four pair limits would be honored. The choice concerned recruitment, disclosure, and the people allowed to see the incomplete parts. The offered six copper was real but not yet hers. Rao's preparation was real whether or not she stood beside his public record. She could decide which consequence she accepted without pretending the technical result would be changed by bravery.

lark_e10_record_choice.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_choice.text: The keeper needed one final answer. Lin could enter the public comparison and its six copper recruitment, accepting a permanent received result that others could read. Or she could take the same mandatory course comparison privately and forgo this appointment's eligibility, keeping the detailed report within the accepted teaching scope. Neither choice supplied another stable pair or reduced the safe task limits.

choices.text: Enter the public comparison and accept its recruitment and disclosure consequences.
Take the private course comparison and forgo this paid appointment.

lark_e10_record_public.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_public.text: Lin entered the public comparison. The keeper read the task conditions aloud before admitting the audience, including the right and duty to stop at an incomplete movement. Shan Fang stood behind the boundary after completing her own lesson. Qin remained at his actual freight booking, and Qin Yi was with her father under the household's accepted arrangement. Lin did not picture them in the room merely because she wanted their support. Rao sat at the other received station, resting the knee while Jiang performed the final ordinary apparatus check.

lark_e10_record_public_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_public_002.text: Lin's first arm pair completed its quarter unit useful task within the unchanged input ceiling. She interrupted, grounded the release, and rested before the second. The audience could see a short controlled light, less dramatic than the stories people told about cultivation. The second arm pair also completed its stated task under the supported low position. Lin felt the ordinary desire to look toward Shan Fang and kept her attention on the resting mark instead. Two received results had been completed. They did not make the remaining tasks automatic.

lark_e10_record_public_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_public_003.text: The changed order put the posterior lower limb task before the anterior one. Lin knew the route and had performed it under other current accepted checks. Here she began too quickly after the ordinary setup changed. The useful result faltered before its criterion. She wanted to continue an extra breath so the light would look whole to the room. The task had no such accepted extension. Lin stopped, grounded the release, and reported the incomplete result. The received public line marked that task interrupted rather than inventing a hidden success behind her sensible decision.

lark_e10_record_public_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_public_004.text: After the specified rest and receiver's current check, she performed the anterior lower limb task. It completed its permitted useful movement and released cleanly. The assessment had three completed tasks and one interrupted task within the four certified pairs. It had no fifth pair attempt, no extra input to replace the missed useful output, and no unexplained reserve beyond the current recovered measurement. Lin's stage certificate was not erased by a failed demonstration, but her eligibility for this appointment required all four tasks under the stated changed order. She had not met that requirement today.

lark_e10_record_public_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_public_005.text: Rao performed after his own accepted setup and current recovery check. He completed the same first and second arm tasks, rested, and handled the changed posterior then anterior lower limb order without Lin's faltering continuation. Every task stopped within its declared ceiling and discharged into the grounded wick. His advantage looked like preparedness repeated across four little jobs. He did not make the room safer by winning; he met the actual appointment's criterion more reliably than she did. The keeper received his complete result and Lin's interrupted one side by side.

lark_e10_record_public_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_public_006.text: Rao won the comparison and was offered the separate Day Seventy Seven inspection. Lin was not offered that six copper job. Nobody changed the conditions afterward to reward her determined attendance. The keeper posted the received public result with the task scopes, not a claim that she lacked worth or would never qualify further. An audience member congratulated her for losing gracefully. Lin did not feel graceful. She thanked him for respecting the stopping rule and declined to make a bright story out of how much she wanted the interrupted line to have been different.

lark_e10_record_public_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_public_007.text: Shan Fang stayed after the audience left. Lin said she had hoped to complete every task and was disappointed. Shan Fang said she had seen the stop, which was useful, and also seen Rao do the changed order better. Lin found the second statement oddly relieving. Her friend did not need to pretend the technical difference was invisible in order to remain her friend. They sat for the ordinary rest before Lin left the room. The public result would remain posted, and the promised lesson was not that losing felt good.

lark_e10_record_public_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_public_008.text: Hu Lan gave Lin a permitted copy of her public receiving. It could show a future employer the tasks she had actually completed and the one she had interrupted. It could not be exchanged for today's qualification or made private after the recruitment closed. Lin filed it beside her course plan rather than hiding it among unrelated household letters. The disclosure was a lasting cost of the choice she made. So was the useful witness that she had stopped under public pressure. Both belonged to an imperfect real result, without a consolation job quietly replacing the missed one.

lark_e10_record_private.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_private.text: Lin selected the private course comparison and declined this appointment's public eligibility before the audience was fixed. Shan Fang received the answer and did not wait outside a room she was not allowed to enter. Rao's public comparison would proceed under its actual recruitment conditions. The keeper scheduled Lin's private task first, with competent receivers and no household spectators. She had chosen privacy and lost a real chance at the six copper appointment. Her choice did not spare her the technical comparison that the accepted course required.

lark_e10_record_private_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_private_002.text: The first and second arm pair tasks completed their permitted quarter unit useful movements at the supported low board, each within the unchanged half unit input ceiling across four ordinary breaths. Lin interrupted, discharged, and rested between them. Duan received the results without applause. The absence of a crowd removed one pressure and left others. She still wanted the changed task to justify her paid instruction. Privacy could not make the incomplete fifth pair become relevant to a four certified pair assessment. The new route remained outside this task.

lark_e10_record_private_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_private_003.text: The changed ordinary order placed the posterior lower limb task before the anterior one. Lin began with the correct references and hurried the transition after the changed setup. The useful movement faltered. With no audience watching, she had less excuse to blame embarrassment for what happened. She stopped rather than extending the declared task by another breath. Jiang's external record showed the incomplete useful result and the full grounded discharge. Duan received it as interrupted work. The private room had not turned careful observation into an easier passing condition.

lark_e10_record_private_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_private_004.text: After the stated rest and current check, her anterior lower limb pair completed its permitted useful movement. The received assessment held three completed tasks and one interrupted task. Her existing fifth stage certificate remained an actual earlier recovered result; this current changed order still revealed a limitation worth addressing. No extra input was used to fill the missing task, and no imagined fifth pair task substituted for it. Lin's choice had protected the detailed report's receiving scope. It had not protected her from the knowledge of where she faltered.

lark_e10_record_private_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_private_005.text: Rao then performed the same task set before its competent receivers under his own current recovered conditions. Lin attended the permitted observation and saw him handle the changed order without the incomplete movement she had just made. He used no larger input ceiling for these registered tasks. His six stable pairs and longer preparation let him control the familiar routes more reliably. The receiver put the complete result beside her private course comparison without pretending the two performances were equal. Rao was better at this work today, in a way she could identify.

lark_e10_record_private_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_private_006.text: His public receiving met the appointment's criterion and produced the separate Day Seventy Seven inspection offer. Lin had already declined eligibility, and her interrupted comparison would not have met the criterion anyway. The private report stayed with the course receivers under its accepted scope. The market audience saw Rao's actual result without Lin's detailed task lines. A later casual reader could not demand that report merely because the person knew her name. A competent new request could still seek its relevant disclosure with permission; privacy was bounded custody, not an agreement to falsify her limitations.

lark_e10_record_private_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_private_007.text: Duan asked how she wanted to use the interrupted line. Lin wanted to hide it until another test worked. He said it could remain private and still stay visible to her. They marked a future changed order practice within the existing twenty meeting scope. The missing useful result became a task she could work toward rather than a public reputation she needed to dispute. There was no additional meeting delivered free because disappointment had made the paid plan feel too small. She accepted the revised emphasis and left its actual date in the course register.

lark_e10_record_private_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_record_private_008.text: Outside, Shan Fang asked whether she wished to talk about the assessment. Lin offered the three completed tasks and the interrupted changed order without opening the private receiver's detailed record. Her friend said that sounded disappointing and useful. It was. Lin had kept control over public disclosure and forgone an actual recruitment opportunity. She had still seen Rao outperform her at the same bounded tasks. The two women walked to the shrine room slowly, where a glove needed a patch indifferent to either practitioner's rank.

lark_e10_after_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_001.text: The technical comparison ended on Day Seventy Five with Rao's complete task set received and Lin's changed order interruption recorded within its actual public or private scope. The offered inspection belonged to him if he accepted its separate conditions. Lin's existing employment belonged to the ordinary work she could safely perform, not to a prize redistributed because she had lost. She left the room after the required rest and found the market continuing its afternoon. A seller was angry about bruised plums. Nobody had paused every other life to observe her disappointment.

lark_e10_after_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_002.text: Duan walked with her as far as the gentler landing. His cane made a soft sound on the dry stone. He asked whether the shoulder had changed during the task. It had not. That ordinary result mattered even when it offered no comfort about the incomplete useful movement. She had stopped before creating a new strain to make an audience's picture look whole. Duan did not call the stop a secret victory over Rao. Rao had done the tasks better. Lin had performed the necessary safe part of a comparison she did not win.

lark_e10_after_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_003.text: She said she hated the phrase useful loss. Duan agreed that it could sound like somebody selling disappointment as a service. The loss might be useful if she used its actual information. It could also become another story she repeated about unfairness without changing any practice. He left the choice of that work with her, inside the instruction already paid and accepted. She did not have to enjoy today's result to read it accurately tomorrow. They reached the turn where his lodging lay, and he left her to walk her own way home.

lark_e10_after_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_004.text: Lin bought no consolation at the market. She had wanted a carved needle case earlier in the term and knew how easily a purchase could become proof that one deserved pleasure despite failure. She could buy it another day if its actual use justified the price. Today she went to lodging, ate the ordinary meal she had already received, and washed her bowl. The soup did not ask whether she had completed four changed tasks. Its warmth was a simpler thing than reassurance, which made it easier to accept.

lark_e10_after_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_005.text: The afternoon's incomplete movement kept returning while she rinsed the cloth beside her basin. She caught herself rehearsing an imaginary version in which the next breath had completed the light. That version required the unaccepted extension she had refused. It was not the test she took. Lin let the cloth drip and wrote one question: what had made the setup change pull her into haste? The answer would not be a hidden reserve or a more sympathetic audience. The reference had been correct. Her transition had not yet become dependable.

lark_e10_after_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_006.text: A neighbor knocked with the lodging keeper's ordinary request to move a small stool away from the shared stair. Lin had left it there while drying the glove. She moved it and apologized for the actual obstruction without turning the small correction into evidence that every part of her day was failing. The neighbor thanked her and continued upstairs carrying a crying infant. Lin could hear the child settle after a kettle lid rattled. The world had several kinds of interruption, and not all of them needed to be entered in a cultivation record.

lark_e10_after_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_007.text: Qin came by after his completed freight receiving. He did not know the comparison's detailed result and asked whether she wished to tell him. Lin named Rao's complete task set and her interrupted changed order. Qin wanted to know if anybody had been hurt. Nobody had. He said that was good, then waited instead of asking her to regard it as the whole answer. Lin told him she had wanted the paid inspection opportunity as well as the technical success. He understood a missed job more readily than an incomplete quarter unit light.

lark_e10_after_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_008.text: Qin had lost a freight appointment once by overloading his afternoon with accepted errands. He had received no cancellation pay because he had not kept his own arrival condition. It was an ordinary failure he remembered whenever a new offer sounded easy to fit. Lin asked whether he still wished he had taken every errand. He said he wished he had chosen three of them honestly instead of imagining himself a man who could occupy four roads. The memory did not tell her how to open a pair. It told her that disappointment could coexist with a useful next habit.

lark_e10_after_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_009.text: Shan Fang sent a sleeve whose owner had asked whether Lin could read the sewn laundry mark before a repair. Lin read only that mark, then returned the sleeve to its keeper. The little request was within the actual permission and needed no display of cultivation. She was glad to do something whose result arrived plainly in another person's hand. Shan Fang thanked her after receiving it and asked whether she wanted the household's evening company. Lin accepted for an hour, with the night's rest still her own.

lark_e10_after_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_010.text: Qin Yi had made a paper medal for the goat. It read best examiner because the goat had found the wrong shoe. She asked whether Lin wanted one too. Lin said she had not been the best operator at the day's comparison. The child offered to write best guest instead. Shan Fang asked what task that medal measured. Qin Yi said guests were measured by how well they watched plays. Lin had missed some real scenes under her own evening choice. She thanked the child for wanting to honor her and let the goat keep its particular prize.

lark_e10_after_011.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_011.text: The household did not spend the whole hour consoling her. Shan Fang needed to cut winter cloth for two paid repairs, and Qin wanted to know which of his shirts could survive another patch. Lin sat by the window while the adults measured. Qin Yi watched the ruler's end and announced each fraction incorrectly. The errors became a game only after the actual cloth marks had been made by Shan Fang. Lin felt her disappointment lose its authority over every conversation. It remained part of the day, no longer the room's whole furniture.

lark_e10_after_012.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_012.text: On Day Seventy Six, Duan's eighth formal teaching meeting addressed the hurried setup transition without attempting Lin's new fifth pair. Her certified posterior lower limb pair would begin only after she named the changed board reference, the next release, and the rest condition. He used three unpowered arrangements before the powered task. Lin found that the one most likely to confuse her had an ordinary support mark at a different angle. She had learned the room's appearance alongside the route and had mistaken one for a dependable cue to the other.

lark_e10_after_013.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_013.text: The powered task used the same current ceiling, with the ordinary supported position and independent apparatus check. This time the changed setup was named before the trace entered. Lin completed the permitted quarter unit useful movement and interrupted cleanly. Duan received the task as one practice result under this condition. It did not revise yesterday's recruitment outcome or erase the interrupted line. She would need repeated recovered changed order work for dependable control. The eighth meeting's four copper was paid for actual instruction, leaving twelve formal meetings and forty eight copper.

lark_e10_after_014.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_014.text: Lin's eighteenth ordinary work shift had been received on Day Seventy Four before the comparison, adding four copper and bringing wages to seventy two. She kept that work paper beside the new practice result as two actual receipts that answered different questions. Her employer had received a useful six hours at the low desk. Her teacher had received a better stopped task after identifying a bad transition cue. Neither fact could be exchanged for the missed Day Seventy Seven appointment. She went downstairs with a clearer plan and the same earned money.

lark_e10_after_015.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_015.text: Rao accepted the inspection offer after checking that its two hour seated scope fit his present knee and recovery. The association's current operating account held its six copper fee; Lin's six hundred copper term supplied none of it. He asked Jiang Tao for the apparatus's current condition record before beginning, rather than inferring it from the board's successful comparison yesterday. A tool that had worked could still require a new ordinary check after its cover was moved. Lin saw him make that request from the public receiving window and recognized another part of his advantage.

lark_e10_after_016.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_016.text: The inspection on Day Seventy Seven found a worn clamp screw before the next practice slot. Rao received the agreed ordinary replacement from the apparatus keeper and checked the stopped fitting after it was installed. No new talisman pattern or additional input was tested under that repair. The keeper received his completed two hour scope and paid six copper from the declared operating account. Rao had won a real job, performed it, and earned its payment. Lin did not acquire the same fee by having learned something useful from his success.

lark_e10_after_017.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_017.text: He came to the lower desk afterward with the receipt folded beside his current task note. Lin congratulated him for the completed work. He said the inspection had been less entertaining than the public comparison and more likely to prevent a bad afternoon. She asked whether he had expected a worn screw. He had expected to look for several ordinary faults without knowing which one would be present. The qualification let him perform a careful inspection. It did not make the world's defects politely announce themselves before he opened the cover.

lark_e10_after_018.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_018.text: Lin wanted to ask if her missed transition had looked foolish. She asked instead what he had done when the support mark changed. Rao described his own preparation and the fixed reference he used before admitting the trace. It matched the part Duan had identified, without a secret shortcut that would make yesterday's loss unfair. Rao had practiced the change until his pause became reliable. Lin could begin that work. She could not borrow the years of repetitions by treating a precise explanation as if it contained a completed habit.

lark_e10_after_019.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_019.text: Outside, the caravan keeper posted a two day delay for one upper branch after a current slope inspection. Fresh stones had fallen into an unoccupied working bay. The qualified crew closed that bay and checked the adjoining ground before accepting another load. The closure did not establish that a large avalanche was certain. It established that the ordinary route had changed and that waiting cargo needed a new received place. Some merchants liked the distinction less than they liked accusing the keeper of dramatizing the weather. The empty bay remained closed.

lark_e10_after_020.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_020.text: Qin brought a booking he could no longer perform under its original route condition. The freight receiver offered a currently open lower alternative and a revised price for the extra turn. Qin could accept the new job or take the stated cancellation term. He accepted the lower alternative after inspecting its actual waiting place. Lin read the amended scope when he asked, then let him make the agreement with his own keeper. His livelihood did not become safe merely because the route had changed on paper. It became a task he could presently inspect and perform.

lark_e10_after_021.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_021.text: The new lower waiting place lay beside a household water channel. Its keeper refused to let cargo stand across the cover, where residents needed ordinary access. The carrier's first stack plan had overlooked that use. Qin moved the crates within the accepted freight square and left the channel clear. A resident thanked him, then complained that the corner was still noisier than before. He said the revised route had that cost. Lin liked the blunt answer. A necessary arrangement could improve one danger without being pleasant for every person who now lived beside its work.

lark_e10_after_022.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_022.text: Jiang Tao called a current signal coordination meeting at the association's lower room. The freight bell's external reserve and rated relay belonged to the operational keeper. Its signal could carry an accepted warning to named receiving stations; it could not restrain the slope or turn an unknown sound into a verified all clear. Ordinary lower lane guides and the counterweight shutdown crew would have separate jobs. The roles would need actual people, current limits, and planned relief. Jiang wanted those agreements made before weather forced everybody to discover what the word help had concealed.

lark_e10_after_023.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_023.text: Lin attended as a person with a safe ordinary desk role and an incomplete new route. Jiang offered no invitation to power the main bell from her body. A limited volunteer watch might fit her current recovery plan if accepted separately. She could serve at one ordinary post: reading standardized receiving marks beside his isolated relay, guiding a lower lane waiting group under the route keeper, or recording the counterweight crew's posted shutdown at a grounded station. The posts would not be combined into a personal quest across all the hazardous bays.

lark_e10_after_024.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_024.text: The guide's name was Ke Wen. He had worked the gallery's ground plan long enough to know which shelter walls were independent of its loaded supports. He showed the current clear exits on an ordinary public sketch and asked Lin which one she had actually walked. She named the lower inspected loop. He would not send her along an unvisited upper bay with only a diagram and confidence. The guide's skill was ordinary qualified work, not a realm she could infer from the number of keys he carried on his belt.

lark_e10_after_025.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_025.text: The counterweight keeper showed the receiving board at the ground station. Qualified operators would handle its actual hardware. An ordinary recorder could receive the closed indication, compare it with the posted scope, and carry the accepted message to the lower desk. The recorder would not catch a suspended load or release an unreceived lever because a crate looked valuable. Lin traced the message's route with her finger while the keeper named the people at both ends. The board had a clear place in a system that needed every part to stop at its own limit.

lark_e10_after_026.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_026.text: The relay bed stood farther uphill, reached by a currently inspected ordinary approach. Jiang would control the rated signal under its own external fuel and isolation. The helper's task concerned received marks and messages, not an unexplained personal surge when the bell needed more strength. A waterproof case there held the current operating log. Its information mattered because the bed's timings and accepted closures were not all duplicated at the lower desk. Lin asked whether the case could leave the bed in an ordinary evacuation. Jiang said only under the named operator's accepted custody plan.

lark_e10_after_027.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_027.text: At the lower lane, a pattern packet from the shrine room would accompany the walking group if the route keeper accepted it as light permitted baggage. The packet held the neighbors' own consented repair patterns and working notes, gathered over years. Its keeper planned to take it along during the current closure rather than leave it in the room's low dry cupboard. Shan Fang had asked Lin to remember which adult actually received it. Lin's friendship gave her interest in the pages; it did not let her promise they would survive every route choice.

lark_e10_after_028.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_028.text: The counterweight station had a brass timing comb used to compare ordinary sequential closures. It belonged to the qualified crew and stayed in a rated low carrying case when not in use. Lin had seen its marks in a public demonstration, not learned every private dimension. The keeper said a recorder there could receive the case during a planned withdrawal after the hardware had been safely closed. Its narrow use made it valuable precisely because no convenient new object on the market could instantly replace the crew's received comparison method.

lark_e10_after_029.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_029.text: Ke Wen put the three posts on the current plan without describing any one as the heroic place. Each had a different group of people and a different useful record nearby. Qualified crews would still hold the dangerous tasks, and Lin's current shoulder restriction would remain. The planned volunteer period would be two ordinary hours on Day Eighty, with named relief. Tomorrow's meeting on Day Seventy Nine would offer the final assignment after the newest inspection. She had agreed only to hear the terms so far. Hearing all three did not staff any of them.

lark_e10_after_030.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_030.text: She asked what happened if the slope changed before the volunteer period ended. The posted evacuation would take precedence over receiving a valuable object or completing a useful form. The relay, lane, and counterweight plans each had an ordinary withdrawal path and a receiver at its end. Those paths could still be obstructed by an actual event, which was why the qualified crew checked them rather than relying on an old map. Ke Wen said no plan made stone harmless. The point was to reduce the number of decisions people had to invent while stone was moving.

lark_e10_after_031.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_031.text: Lin carried the offered ordinary roles to the clinician's current low activity plan. Nothing authorized lifting above the comfortable limit, running while strain altered her gait, or powering an apparatus outside her tested task. She would ask for the newest ordinary assessment if her condition changed before volunteering. The possible watch did not replace the paid desk shifts she had already accepted. Her nineteenth shift was received on Day Seventy Seven, adding four copper and bringing wages to seventy six. The money was for completed safe work, not for promising herself available to a future alarm.

lark_e10_after_032.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_032.text: At the shrine room, Shan Fang sorted the pattern packet with two owners whose pages had different permissions. Public stitch examples went in one fold; private customer measurements remained elsewhere. The planned walking packet contained only the material its keepers had actually consented to carry together. Lin watched them remove one household sleeve diagram before sealing the fold. The missing diagram made the packet less complete for their work and more properly bounded for shared custody. Ke Wen's plan would take a real object with a real keeper, not a convenient bundle of every important memory.

lark_e10_after_033.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_033.text: Qin Yi wanted to put the giant shoe in the packet too. Shan Fang said its ordinary performance tray would stay with the child and its size had not been accepted in the light route baggage. The child proposed drawing a smaller shoe on the packet's cover. Lin asked the owners, who permitted a little ordinary mark beside the receiving label. The packet acquired the shoe without acquiring another bulky object. The joke survived by changing form under actual permission, which was a more useful answer than telling a child that seriousness had banned it.

lark_e10_after_034.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_after_034.text: Lin went to bed before the market's last argument ended. She had lost a technical comparison, seen the better prepared worker earn its real job, and received another ordinary desk shift herself. The fifth pair still required changed order practice and the sixth was still unopened. Tomorrow would bring a current slope notice and a new offer of bounded work, rather than a promise that the mountain waited for her qualification. She folded the volunteer plan beside the clinician's note. Whatever she chose, she would take one body to one post.

lark_e10_walk_1.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_walk_1.text: Before Lin left the coordination room, Ke Wen offered to walk the open receiving paths with her in daylight. She accepted the ordinary route inside her present limits. They visited the relay approach, the lane's lower meeting place, and the counterweight station's doorway without entering closed working bays. The three posts stopped being marks on a sheet. Their distances mattered to a person who would be unable to do all three.

lark_e10_walk_2.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_walk_2.text: At the shelter, Ke Wen showed her the occupancy sign and the clear passage beside its wall. He knew the building's history but used its current inspected plan. A former keeper's memory could not prove that a later repair had preserved every support. Lin looked at the receiver's place, where an arriving group would actually be counted. She could now describe the destination without pretending she had inspected its structure herself.

lark_e10_walk_3.speaker: narrator
lark_e10_walk_3.text: Ke Wen carried a double flute in his coat and played it while they rested at the lower landing. He had learned the tune from his father, who forgot a different phrase each time he taught it. Lin recognized the freight departure rhythm beneath its ornament. The guide laughed and played the version for her. It was a moment to know him beyond the keys at his belt and the plans he received.
